name: Eternal Wings
look: a feathered violet and white Latias with huge wings of scalloped violet coverts and white eye-spotted flight feathers, a feather fan of a tail and a glowing blue visor over its eye
entry: It flies through the sky surrounded by a powerful aura. Its presence is said to draw out good feelings in everyone nearby, and to make people believe whatever they wish to.
how: Wild: very rare at night on tropical islands and in meadows.
